dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: Hi, I'm the landlord. Come in! This is the apartment.
dialogue.reading: ˈhaɪ, aɪm ðə ˈlændlɔːrd. ˈkʌm ˈɪn! ˈðɪs ɪz ði əˈpɑːrtmənt.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Oh, it's really nice. How much is the rent?
dialogue.reading: ˈoʊ, ɪts ˈriːli ˈnaɪs. ˈhaʊ ˈmʌtʃ ɪz ðə ˈrɛnt?

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: It's five thousand baht a month.
dialogue.reading: ɪts ˈfaɪv ˈθaʊzənd ˈbɑːt ə ˈmʌnθ.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: OK. Can I have a cat here? I love cats.
dialogue.reading: oʊˈkeɪ. kən aɪ ˈhæv ə ˈkæt ˈhɪr? aɪ ˈlʌv ˈkæts.

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: Sorry, you can't have pets in the apartment.
dialogue.reading: ˈsɑːri, juː ˈkænt ˈhæv ˈpɛts ɪn ði əˈpɑːrtmənt.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Oh. Can my friends visit me?
dialogue.reading: ˈoʊ. kən maɪ ˈfrɛndz ˈvɪzɪt miː?

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: Yes, they can. But you can't smoke in the room.
dialogue.reading: ˈjɛs, ðeɪ ˈkæn. bʌt juː ˈkænt ˈsmoʊk ɪn ðə ˈruːm.
